trial_court: Additional Senior Civil Judge, Haveri (RA No.19/2009), Civil Judge (Jr.Dn.,) & JMFC, Haveri (OS No.164/2008)
case_name: Smt Basavannevva W/O. Devendrappa ... vs Prakash Mother Renuka Kagammanavar

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt Basavannevva W/O. Devendrappa Kenchallanavar, Smt Gangavva W/O. Dyamananna Vadakammanavar, Smt Shakuntalla @ Shakavva W/O. Sangappa Kattimani
parties.respondent_defendant: Prakash Mother Renuka Kagammanavar, Vijay, Dilleppa S/O. Hanumappa Anni

facts_of_case: Plaintiffs are challenging the judgment and decree passed in RA No.19/2009 and OS No.164/2008 dismissing their suit for declaration.

legal_principles.principle: A compromise decree is not binding on parties who are not parties to the suit.
legal_principles.held: The said compromise is not binding on the Plaintiffs. Hence, he submits that both the Courts have erred in dismissing the suit filed by the Plaintiffs.

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot seek a right over property without nullifying the compromise decree.
legal_principles.held: Without nullifying the said decree, the Plaintiffs cannot seek any right over the suit property.

legal_principles.principle: A party's failure to challenge a judgment and decree passed in another suit does not affect the finality of that judgment.
legal_principles.held: The present Plaintiff No.1 has failed to challenge the judgment and decree passed in O.S. No.127/2004. Hence, I am of the opinion that the same is final and conclusive one on its merits.

outcome.final_order: The trial court's decision was affirmed by the first appellate Court, and this appeal is also dismissed.

use_for_drafting: guiding clients on joint family settlements
